authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: considering everything together

examples.en: Overall sales improved this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季的整體銷售有所改善。

entries.en: officially acceptable or still usable

examples.en: Your passport must remain valid during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中你的護照必須保持有效。

entries.en: forming an essential basis

examples.en: Trust is fundamental to a business partnership.
examples.zh: 信任是商業合作的根本。

entries.en: relating to health care

examples.en: The company covers certain medical expenses.
examples.zh: 公司負擔部分醫療費用。

entries.en: easy to reach or use

examples.en: The building is accessible to wheelchair users.
examples.zh: 輪椅使用者可以進出這棟建築。

entries.en: added to what already exists

examples.en: Additional chairs are available on request.
examples.zh: 如有需要可提供額外椅子。

entries.en: fair and sensible

examples.en: The supplier offered a reasonable price.
examples.zh: 供應商提出了合理價格。

entries.en: suitable for a particular situation

examples.en: Wear appropriate clothing for the site visit.
examples.zh: 實地參訪時請穿著合適的服裝。

entries.en: intended to last indefinitely

examples.en: She was offered a permanent position.
examples.zh: 她獲得了一個長期職位。

entries.en: available in large amounts

examples.en: The region has abundant natural resources.
examples.zh: 這個地區擁有豐富的天然資源。

entries.en: without a person's name being known

examples.en: Employees can submit anonymous feedback.
examples.zh: 員工可以匿名提供意見。

entries.en: covering a large area or subject

examples.en: The role requires extensive travel.
examples.zh: 這個職位需要經常出差。

entries.en: possible but not yet actual

examples.en: We contacted several potential buyers.
examples.zh: 我們聯絡了幾位潛在買家。

entries.en: relating to specialized practical knowledge

examples.en: Contact support for technical assistance.
examples.zh: 需要技術協助請聯絡支援人員。

entries.en: completely necessary

examples.en: Accurate records are essential for audits.
examples.zh: 準確的紀錄對稽核至關重要。

entries.en: relating to skilled work or proper conduct

examples.en: The staff provided professional service.
examples.zh: 員工提供了專業服務。

entries.en: relating to buying and selling

examples.en: The site is approved for commercial use.
examples.zh: 這個地點已獲准作商業用途。

entries.en: located in another country across the sea

examples.en: Our overseas office handles regional orders.
examples.zh: 我們的海外辦公室負責區域訂單。

entries.en: neither very large nor very small

examples.en: We expect moderate growth next year.
examples.zh: 我們預期明年將溫和成長。

entries.en: more than usual or than others

examples.en: This model is particularly popular with students.
examples.zh: 這個型號特別受學生歡迎。

entries.en: close to a number but not exact

examples.en: Delivery takes approximately five working days.
examples.zh: 配送大約需要五個工作天。

entries.en: to give full attention to something

examples.en: Please concentrate on the most urgent task.
examples.zh: 請專注於最緊急的任務。

entries.en: to copy digitally or look through quickly

examples.en: Scan the receipt and attach it.
examples.zh: 請掃描收據並附上檔案。

entries.en: to move an event to a later time

examples.en: We postponed the picnic because of rain.
examples.zh: 我們因下雨延後了野餐。

entries.en: to arrange an event for a different time

examples.en: Please reschedule my appointment for Friday.
examples.zh: 請將我的預約改到星期五。

entries.en: to cause a change in something

examples.en: The road closure will affect deliveries.
examples.zh: 道路封閉將影響配送。

entries.en: to say what may happen in the future

examples.en: Analysts predict higher demand this winter.
examples.zh: 分析師預測今年冬季需求會增加。

entries.en: to officially join a course or program

examples.en: You can enroll in the course online.
examples.zh: 你可以在線上報名這門課程。

entries.en: to travel regularly between home and work

examples.en: She commutes by train each day.
examples.zh: 她每天搭火車通勤。

entries.en: to include something as a necessary part

examples.en: The job involves frequent customer visits.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要經常拜訪顧客。

entries.en: to pause because you are uncertain

examples.en: Do not hesitate to ask for assistance.
examples.zh: 需要協助時請別猶豫。

entries.en: to give money or goods for a cause

examples.en: We donated unused desks to a school.
examples.zh: 我們將閒置書桌捐給學校。

entries.en: to send something onward to another person

examples.en: Forward the message to your supervisor.
examples.zh: 請將訊息轉寄給主管。

entries.en: to successfully reach a goal

examples.en: The team achieved its annual target.
examples.zh: 團隊達成了年度目標。

entries.en: to give something or help cause a result

examples.en: Every department contributed to the project.
examples.zh: 每個部門都對專案有所貢獻。

entries.en: to make something last longer or reach further

examples.en: We extended the deadline by one week.
examples.zh: 我們將期限延長了一週。

entries.en: to be made up of certain parts

examples.en: The package consists of three training modules.
examples.zh: 這套課程由三個訓練單元組成。

entries.en: to communicate or act with others

examples.en: Participants will interact in small groups.
examples.zh: 參與者將分成小組互動。

entries.en: to show or suggest something

examples.en: The results indicate strong customer interest.
examples.zh: 結果顯示顧客很感興趣。

entries.en: to happen or take place

examples.en: Minor delays may occur during maintenance.
examples.zh: 維護期間可能發生短暫延誤。

entries.en: to tell someone confidently that something is true

examples.en: We assured clients that their data was safe.
examples.zh: 我們向客戶保證資料安全。

entries.en: to get someone to act through reasoning

examples.en: The demonstration persuaded us to buy.
examples.zh: 這場示範說服了我們購買。

entries.en: to make someone believe something

examples.en: The results convinced investors of the plan's value.
examples.zh: 這些成果使投資人相信計畫的價值。

entries.en: to use equipment or run a business

examples.en: Only trained staff may operate this machine.
examples.zh: 只有受過訓練的人員能操作這台機器。

entries.en: to state something officially

examples.en: Declare any restricted goods at customs.
examples.zh: 請向海關申報管制物品。

entries.en: to make a change to something

examples.en: We may alter the schedule if necessary.
examples.zh: 必要時我們可能調整時程。

entries.en: to keep something in good condition

examples.en: Regular checks maintain product quality.
examples.zh: 定期檢查能維持產品品質。

entries.en: to give someone a job or use something

examples.en: The factory employs over two hundred people.
examples.zh: 這間工廠雇用超過兩百人。

entries.en: to put parts together

examples.en: Workers assemble the units on site.
examples.zh: 工人在現場組裝這些組件。

entries.en: to give someone a task or role

examples.en: The manager assigned me a new project.
examples.zh: 經理指派我負責一項新專案。

entries.en: to officially accept or allow something

examples.en: Finance approved the equipment purchase.
examples.zh: 財務部核准了設備採購。

entries.en: to offer an idea for consideration

examples.en: She suggested a shorter training session.
examples.zh: 她建議縮短訓練時段。

entries.en: to reach a judgment or bring to an end

examples.en: The meeting concluded with a vote.
examples.zh: 會議以投票作結。

entries.en: to give someone a reason to act

examples.en: Clear goals motivate employees to improve.
examples.zh: 明確的目標能激勵員工進步。

entries.en: to become smaller

examples.en: The market shrank after the price increase.
examples.zh: 價格上漲後市場萎縮了。

entries.en: to formally send something for review

examples.en: Submit the completed form by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前提交填好的表格。

entries.en: to attract attention or produce a picture

examples.en: The exhibition drew many international visitors.
examples.zh: 這場展覽吸引了許多國際訪客。

entries.en: to make a system or service start working

examples.en: Activate your account using the link.
examples.zh: 請透過連結啟用帳戶。

entries.en: to state something or request what is owed

examples.en: Employees can claim approved travel expenses.
examples.zh: 員工可以申請核准的差旅費。

entries.en: to change something slightly to improve it

examples.en: Adjust the screen brightness before use.
examples.zh: 使用前請調整螢幕亮度。

entries.en: to encourage sales or raise someone's position

examples.en: The campaign promotes our new product line.
examples.zh: 這項活動推廣我們的新產品系列。

entries.en: to change to suit new conditions

examples.en: We adapted the design for smaller screens.
examples.zh: 我們調整了設計以適用較小的螢幕。

entries.en: to resolve a problem or pay what is owed

examples.en: Please settle the invoice before departure.
examples.zh: 請在離開前結清發票款項。

entries.en: to change a document or plan

examples.en: We revised the proposal after receiving feedback.
examples.zh: 收到回饋後，我們修訂了提案。

entries.en: to spend money expecting future benefits

examples.en: The company invested in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 公司投資了再生能源。

entries.en: to find where something is

examples.en: Staff located the missing package.
examples.zh: 員工找到了遺失的包裹。

entries.en: to show how something works or is true

examples.en: The trainer demonstrated the new software.
examples.zh: 講師示範了新軟體的操作。

entries.en: to state a price or repeat exact words

examples.en: The supplier quoted a lower price.
examples.zh: 供應商報了較低的價格。

entries.en: to move someone to a lower position

examples.en: The manager was demoted after repeated violations.
examples.zh: 這位經理因多次違規而遭降職。

entries.en: to take money out or remove a request

examples.en: You may withdraw your application anytime.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時撤回申請。

entries.en: to have the greatest influence or share

examples.en: Two firms dominate the regional market.
examples.zh: 兩家公司主導了區域市場。

entries.en: to explain something in more detail

examples.en: Could you elaborate on the delivery plan?
examples.zh: 你能詳細說明配送計畫嗎？

entries.en: to completely remove something

examples.en: The update eliminates several common errors.
examples.zh: 這次更新消除了幾種常見錯誤。

entries.en: to expect something and prepare for it

examples.en: We anticipate higher demand during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我們預期假日期間需求會增加。

entries.en: to go beyond a limit or expectation

examples.en: Expenses must not exceed the approved budget.
examples.zh: 支出不得超過核准預算。

entries.en: to officially choose someone for a role

examples.en: They appointed her regional director.
examples.zh: 他們任命她為區域主管。

entries.en: to change something for a particular user

examples.en: You can customize the dashboard layout.
examples.zh: 你可以自訂儀表板配置。

entries.en: to be attractive or request reconsideration

examples.en: The simple design appeals to many buyers.
examples.zh: 這個簡潔設計吸引了許多買家。

entries.en: to promise or devote resources

examples.en: We committed funds to the renovation.
examples.zh: 我們承諾投入整修經費。

entries.en: to keep something continuing

examples.en: Repeat customers help sustain the business.
examples.zh: 回頭客有助於維持業務。

entries.en: to fill or use a space

examples.en: The company occupies the entire floor.
examples.zh: 這家公司使用整層樓。

entries.en: to formally suggest someone for a position

examples.en: Staff nominated her for the service award.
examples.zh: 員工提名她角逐服務獎。

entries.en: to recognize differences between things

examples.en: Clear labels distinguish the product sizes.
examples.zh: 清楚的標籤能區分產品尺寸。

entries.en: to change something into another form

examples.en: Convert the file to PDF before sending.
examples.zh: 寄送前請將檔案轉成 PDF。

entries.en: to combine into a single unit

examples.en: The two departments will merge next month.
examples.zh: 兩個部門將在下個月合併。

entries.en: to follow the progress or location of something

examples.en: Track your package on our website.
examples.zh: 請在我們的網站追蹤包裹。

entries.en: to ask for payment or supply electricity

examples.en: The hotel charges extra for parking.
examples.zh: 飯店另收停車費。

entries.en: to try to do something

examples.en: We attempted to contact the supplier.
examples.zh: 我們曾嘗試聯絡供應商。

entries.en: to display something publicly

examples.en: Local artists will exhibit their work.
examples.zh: 當地藝術家將展出作品。

entries.en: to officially submit or store a document

examples.en: Please file the expense report today.
examples.zh: 請今天提交費用報告。

entries.en: to worry someone or relate to something

examples.en: The rising costs concern our investors.
examples.zh: 成本上升使投資人擔憂。

entries.en: to work as intended

examples.en: The backup system is functioning normally.
examples.zh: 備援系統運作正常。

entries.en: to buy something

examples.en: We purchased new chairs for the office.
examples.zh: 我們為辦公室買了新椅子。

entries.en: to promise a result or quality

examples.en: We guarantee delivery by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們保證星期五前送達。

entries.en: to officially record information or join

examples.en: Register online to reserve your place.
examples.zh: 請在線上報名以保留名額。

entries.en: to rent property under an agreement

examples.en: The company leases its office equipment.
examples.zh: 公司租賃辦公設備。

entries.en: to include something as an important part

examples.en: The exhibition features local designers.
examples.zh: 這場展覽以當地設計師為主角。

entries.en: to fail to make a required payment

examples.en: The borrower defaulted on the loan.
examples.zh: 借款人未履行貸款還款義務。

entries.en: to support an activity with money or resources

examples.en: Our company sponsors the local arts festival.
examples.zh: 我們公司贊助當地藝術節。

entries.en: to fail to work correctly

examples.en: The scanner malfunctioned during registration.
examples.zh: 掃描器在報到時故障了。
